description: Cosmopolitan: 40 ml vodka, 15 ml orange liqueur (0.75 parts), 15 ml lime (0.75), 30 ml cranberry juice (1.5, role lengthener). The optional mixer slot of the Sidecar (0.5 - 6) takes the juice; the Daiquiri has no sweet line and fails. The book files the Cosmopolitan under the Sidecar.
source: docs/templates.md#vectors; expected values worked out by hand from the slot bands in data/templates (assumptions, see the document)
